name: Teen Summer Volunteer (TSV)
what_you_do: Teens give at least 10 hours in one role. The roles are Literacy Advocate (online), Maker Assistant (Mondays and Wednesdays, 2 to 4 pm) and Program Intern. Teens also finish Teen Summer Reading.
who_can_apply: Teens going into grades 8 to 12 who have a Princeton Public Library card in their own name.
duration: At least 10 hours. Program Intern camps run in July and August. In the 2026 cycle, applicants heard back June 15.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 open April 15, 2027. In the usual cycle they close June 5 at 5 pm and decisions come June 15.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Give your library card number and a signed reference form. Spots for Maker Assistant and Program Intern are limited.
notes: The June 5 close date is from the page's 2026 cycle wording; confirm for 2027.
